text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo-san, you look awfully tired... It's 
your birthday and all, so don't go pushing 
yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, don't worry 'bout it, I'm just tired 
of playing the straight man... Every 
single place I go, people keep 
congratulating me... I mean, don't get me 
wrong, it makes me happy, but still...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why does everyone keep sendin' me octopus 
stuff?! Octopus plushies, octopus 
T-shirts, and what-not...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Is it 'cause this is Osaka!? 'Cause of 
takoyaki!? What're we gonna do with all 
these octopuses!? Is this a comedy bit!? 
Ya waitin' for the straight man!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What're we gonna do?! After all that 
fretting, I went and picked an 
octopus-themed present too...! I didn't 
mean to, but now it looks like an 
intentional repeat gag!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Still... I wonder what kind of comeback 
she'll make if I hand this over? ...Darn 
it, now I'm super curious...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Um... truth is, I also prepared a present 
for you. It's, well... takoyaki-flavored 
rice crackers...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...H-Huh!? She's not gonna call me out on 
it...!? Why—)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~! Getting somethin' like this 
makes me wanna hit the beach and go 
surfin'~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's Shonan octopus crackers right 
there! —Gasp! Er, I mean, that is... 
ohoho.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Hahahaha! Nice one, Lala! That was 
sharp! Haaah... It's been so long since 
someone called me out like that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch, this is the best present 
ever! ...While we're at it, I'd appreciate 
it even more if you helped me out with the 
punchlines later, though.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... I'm simply not worthy... 
hehehe.
